title: Mother Holding Baby Beside Young Girl, 1940s Courtyard B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A classic mid-1940s family snapshot featuring a stylish young mother posing outdoors on a sunny walkway flanked by manicured lawns. She wears a tailored padded-shoulder skirt suit, a blouse accented with a striped bow tie, and a sculpted updo typical of the WWII and immediate postwar era. She cradles a swaddled infant in a white blanket and bonnet, while her smiling toddler daughter stands closely beside her in a light dress and knit cardigan. In the background stands a two-story Streamline Moderne style garden apartment building.
